view.base_assets_missing: The base map assets have not been installed. Please download them first to enable map functionality.
view.world_basemap_missing: The world base map has not been downloaded yet, so the map may appear blank outside downloaded regions. Connect this NOMAD to the internet and download it (~15 MB) from Map Settings.
view.no_regions_downloaded: No map regions have been downloaded yet. Please download some regions to enable map functionality.

manager.title: Maps Manager
manager.subtitle: Manage your stored map files and explore new regions!
manager.base_assets_alert: The base map assets have not been installed. Please download them first to enable map functionality.
manager.world_basemap_msg: The low-zoom world base map (~15 MB) hasn't been downloaded yet, so the map appears blank outside any regions you've downloaded. Connect this NOMAD to the internet and download it once for offline use.
manager.global_installed_msg: Your global map build {{date}} ({{size}}) is stored locally and ready for offline use.
manager.global_available_msg: Download a complete worldwide map from Protomaps ({{size}}, build {{date}}). This is a large file but covers the entire planet — no individual region downloads needed.
manager.country_picker_alert_msg: Pick the countries you actually need — from a single country to a whole continent — and we'll pull just those tiles from the global Protomaps archive. Much smaller than the full 125 GB global map.
manager.base_map_download_error: Could not download the base map. Please connect this NOMAD to the internet and try again.
manager.global_map_queued: Global map download has been queued. This is a large file (~125 GB) and may take a while.
manager.global_map_error: Failed to start the global map download. Please try again.
manager.base_assets_error: An error occurred while downloading the base map assets. Please try again.
manager.collection_queued: Download for collection "{{name}}" has been queued.
manager.all_resources_downloaded: All resources in the collection "{{name}}" have already been downloaded.
manager.file_delete_failed: Failed to delete {{name}}. Please try again.
manager.modal_delete_msg: Are you sure you want to delete {{name}}? This action cannot be undone.
manager.modal_download_msg: Are you sure you want to download <1>{{name}}</1>? It may take some time for it to be available depending on the file size and your internet connection.
manager.modal_global_msg: This will download the full Protomaps global map ({{size}}, build {{date}}). Covers the entire planet so you won't need individual region files. Make sure you have enough disk space.
